Name: Succulents for Content Patcher
Author: Saah
Description:
[size=5]Description
[/size]
[size=4]About the original mod[/size]
Converted from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5310]Succulents for Json Assets[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url].

The original mod wasn't working anymore and DustBeauty's profile says "If my mod is broken by new game updates, and your contact send to me is not answered for more than a month, you can share the conversion or your fixed file for the benefits of others." I sent a DM in April 26th, 2024, and haven't gotten an answer yet.

I haven't and will not change anything about the mod, all I did was convert it. Any crafted succulents, succulent starters, or succulent sap you have in your save file will be automatically converted as soon as you remove the original mod and install this one, but your succulent crops will become error crops.

[size=4]Features
[/size]Ten (or nine) craftable succulents:[list]
[*]Small Balloon Cactus and Barbary Fig, unlocked once you reach Farming level 2
[*]Euphoria Trigona and Hedgehog Cactus, unlocked once you reach Farming level 3
[*]Pencil Cactus, unlocked once you reach Farming level 4
[*]Pachyveria Glauca, Rebutia, and Senecio Anteuphorbium, unlocked by default
[*]Group Succulents, a shelf of succulents made of two halves. Both recipes are purchasable from Sandy for 1,000g each
[*]All succulents require 2 Clay and 1 Cactus Fruit, except for both halves of Group Succulents, which require an additional Iron Bar

[/list]
Two crop succulents, Decorative Succulents and Edible Succulents:
[list]
[*]Decorative Succulents yields its own starter, and Edible Succulents yields Succulent Sap. Succulent Sap grants you 50 energy and 22 health, and can be gifted to characters.
[*]Both are available in Spring, Summer, and Fall
[*]They don't need watering
[*]Both take 14 days to grow
[*]Decorative Succulents will regrow five days after being harvested. Edible Succulents will regrow in three days instead
[*]You have a chance to harvest one additional produce (starter/sap)
[*]Starters can be bought from Sandy
[/list]Chinese and Korean (by KAYA) translations from the original mod included.

[size=5]Requirements
[/size][list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 2.1.2+
[/list]
[size=5]Known Issues and Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*]No known incompatibilities, but it might not play nice with any succulent mods that have the same species and don't use unique IDs. If you find items from another mod magically becoming items from this mod, tell me the mod name because I can write a quick patch in two minutes and one line, but also let the author know they should always use unique IDs.

[*]The automatic conversion of items from the original mod won't work on planted crops.
[*]Crops are very wobbly in their first days. I have no idea why that happens.
[*]The Chinese translation is missing its string for "Decorative Succulents Starter".

[/list]
